marketBrief.headline: Midday, Nov. 12: Stocks recover after an Nvidia-led open as the 10-year yield tops 5% again
marketBrief.summary: Around noon ET the Dow was up 0.3%, the S&P 500 up 0.2% and the Nasdaq Composite up 0.1%, per Yahoo Finance, after Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% at the open on the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang (AP). Treasury trading resumed after the Veterans Day holiday, and the 10-year yield rose to about 5.09% (Yahoo Finance). CME FedWatch prices a quarter-point December hike as a certainty, with a half-point move at about 13% (CNBC).
bullets: Nvidia: Huang resigned as CEO and director effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO (CNBC). Shares were down about 4.7% at 11:14 a.m. ET after falling as much as 14% at the open (AP).
Midday: Dow 52,653.86, up 0.32% at 11:57:48 a.m. ET (Yahoo Finance quote data). AMD and Broadcom rose; Intel and Micron fell (Yahoo Finance; AP).
Treasuries: 10-year 5.068% earlier in the session, up more than 7 bp; 2-year 4.843%; 30-year 5.40% (CNBC). Yahoo Finance had the 10-year at 5.09% by midday.
Jobless claims rose 9,000 to 200,000 in the week ended Nov. 7, above forecasts (Labor Department release, Nov. 12).
Bitcoin traded below $72,000, its lowest level since mid-August, with spot ETF outflows and the MSCI exit of Strategy weighing (Bitcoin Magazine).
Nebius reported Q3 revenue of $980.8 million, up 571%, but shares fell 16% on capex and a cautious outlook (CNBC; Business Wire).

calendar.event: Cisco and Applied Materials quarterly results
calendar.why: Both report after Thursday's close; Applied Materials options were pricing about a 10% move (Investopedia; Startup Fortune).
BLS schedule lists Nov. 13 at 8:30 a.m. CNBC expects a 0.4% monthly rise after September's 1.3% surge.
Anthropic's price range is $70 to $78 a share; the company expects to price Nov. 18 (CNBC, Nov. 10; Yahoo Finance live, Nov. 12).

calendar.event: Anthropic shares expected to begin trading
calendar.why: Anthropic said shares are expected to begin trading Nov. 19 (EST), per Yahoo Finance live coverage. Timing can change.

calendar.event: MSCI removal of Strategy (MSTR) and Metaplanet takes effect
calendar.why: MSCI's November review removes Strategy from its USA index; index funds may sell shares before the close (CoinReporter; Yahoo Finance).
FedRateCalc and Tickward list Dec. 8-9, citing the Fed calendar. CME FedWatch prices a quarter-point hike at 100% with a half-point move near 13% (CNBC).
